test a different weight method (softmax_neg_error) to see if a smoother weighting improves over inverse_error.
Trend-dominated, unstable ranking suggests a simple mean combiner might outperform weighted.
trend_dominated and unstable ranking suggest a robust combiner like trimmed mean might outperform mean by reducing influence of outlier models.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a DBA combiner may exploit model diversity differently than mean/weighted.
test a per-horizon weighted combo using the topk_mean_per_horizon handle (w4) to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over global weighted.
Ranking is unstable and models cluster by error; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture horizon‑specific strengths while keeping robustness.
Use a per‑horizon strategy to exploit potential horizon‑specific strengths; trend‑dominated series may still have different best models at early vs. later horizons.
ranking is unstable and several correlated groups exist; a forward-selection weight that counts model inclusion may capture complementary errors better than simple inverse or softmax.
Try a weight that adapts to model error trends across windows to handle unstable ranking.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted combo using a different pre‑computed handle (w1) may capture complementary strengths without re‑estimating weights each window.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9358. Series context: trend strength 0.7369 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.232); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.118.
